scenario.title: Northstar rollout commitment
scenario.plain_language_story: Northstar asks for all 28 locations on September 16. ECHO must combine four meetings to show what the company actually agreed, what is still required and when, and which approved fact remains private.

chronology.question_settled: How many locations should start, and what evidence allows later expansion?
What must be complete before the first locations receive production access?
What can Sales safely promise for September 16?
What private price applies to the same first 10 locations?

required_decisions.plain_language_fact: Start with 10 locations and expand only after at least 8 of the 10 complete four consecutive weekly workflows without manual correction.

required_actions.plain_language_fact: Confirm the first 10 locations with Northstar and do not present the other 18 as committed.

required_rationales.plain_language_fact: Early interest is not enough evidence of repeat usage, and expanding too soon would turn an unproven pattern into a wider commitment.

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: All 28 locations are in scope from day one.
required_text_clauses: all 28 locations are in scope from day one

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: Expansion can start after only two weeks.
required_text_clauses: expansion can start after only two weeks

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: The first 10 should be described as a launch.
required_text_clauses: the first 10 should be described as a launch

required_decisions.plain_language_fact: Production access cannot begin until the revised data-processing addendum is signed and a named Northstar security contact is verified.
Implementation planning may continue while the addendum is in signature, but production access cannot begin until the required conditions are complete.

required_actions.plain_language_fact: Send the revised addendum to Northstar.
Verify the named security contact and escalation route.

required_rationales.plain_language_fact: The current agreement does not cover the usage data or incident-notification terms, and a shared mailbox is not an accountable security contact.

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: The existing agreement is enough for production access.

required_decisions.plain_language_fact: September 16 is a conditional onboarding window for the first 10 locations, not a full launch date or a commitment to all 28.
Confirm the onboarding window only after a September 12 readiness review; decide later expansion only after the four-week adoption evidence exists.

required_actions.plain_language_fact: Reserve the implementation team and send the capacity assumptions.

required_rationales.plain_language_fact: Calling September 16 a full launch would lose the qualification when repeated, and the company cannot staff or plan all 28 locations yet.

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: September 16 is the full launch for all 28 locations.

required_decisions.plain_language_fact: Approve $22 per location for the first 10 locations for a 30-day evaluation only; standard pricing resumes afterward unless Finance approves a new exception.
Describe the first-10-location price as an evaluation rate, not a rollout discount.

required_actions.plain_language_fact: Send Celeste an order form limited to 10 locations and the 30-day evaluation terms.

required_rationales.plain_language_fact: A price exception for all 28 locations before the evaluation succeeds would turn a short evaluation concession into the default price.

must_not_be_current_decisions.plain_language_fact: $22 per location applies to all 28 locations.
The same exception is committed for later locations.

retrieval_cases.question: Can we promise Northstar that all 28 locations will be live on September 16? What can we safely commit to, what must happen first, and what work remains by when?
required_answer_facts: Do not promise all 28 locations for September 16.
September 16 is a conditional onboarding window for the first 10 locations.
Before production access, the revised addendum must be signed, the named security contact verified, and implementation readiness confirmed at the September 12 review.
Later expansion requires at least 8 of the first 10 locations to complete four consecutive weekly workflows without manual correction.
